items.title_en: US supreme court clears way for Trump’s border wall in Texas’s Big Bend
items.title_zh: 美國最高法院為川普在德州大彎曲國家公園的邊境牆建設開綠燈
items.summary_en: The US Supreme Court allowed construction of a border wall to continue. This project includes parts of a national park. The court stopped a lower court order that had paused the work.
items.summary_zh: 美國最高法院允許邊境牆的建設繼續進行。該計畫包含國家公園的部分區域。法院撤銷了先前下令暫停該工程的下級法院裁決。
items.why_important_en: This decision shows how the government prioritizes border control over environmental concerns.
items.why_important_zh: 這項決定顯示政府如何將邊境管制置於環境保護之上。

vocab.sentence_en: The construction of the new office building starts next week.
vocab.sentence_zh: 新辦公大樓的建設將於下週開始。

vocab.definition_en: To stop something for a period of time.
vocab.sentence_en: The manager decided to suspend the meeting until tomorrow morning.
vocab.sentence_zh: 經理決定將會議暫停至明天早上。

items.title_en: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
items.title_zh: 法國指控伊朗透過冰箱攻擊進行網路破壞
items.summary_en: France says hackers from Iran attacked retail stores. They changed the temperatures in refrigerators. This caused a lot of food to spoil.
items.summary_zh: 法國表示來自伊朗的駭客攻擊了零售商店。他們改變了冰箱的溫度，導致大量食物腐壞。
items.why_important_en: This highlights the growing threat of cyberattacks on everyday infrastructure.
items.why_important_zh: 這凸顯了針對日常基礎設施的網路攻擊威脅日益增加。

vocab.definition_en: To try to hurt or damage something.
vocab.sentence_en: The computer virus will attack your files if you click that link.
vocab.sentence_zh: 如果你點擊那個連結，電腦病毒將會攻擊你的檔案。

vocab.definition_en: To become bad and not fit to eat.
vocab.sentence_en: Don't leave the milk out or it will spoil quickly.
vocab.sentence_zh: 別把牛奶放在外面，否則它很快就會壞掉。

items.title_en: What do we know about Nvidia CEO’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy?
items.title_zh: 關於輝達執行長與疑似中國間諜外遇的事件，我們知道什麼？
items.summary_en: Nvidia's CEO is facing news about an affair. People are wondering if his reputation will be hurt. The person involved is suspected of being a spy.
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長正面臨外遇新聞的衝擊。人們好奇他的聲譽是否會受損。涉案者被懷疑是一名間諜。
items.why_important_en: High-profile leaders' personal lives can impact their company's public image.
items.why_important_zh: 知名領導人的私生活可能會影響其公司的公眾形象。

vocab.definition_en: The opinion that people have about someone or something.
vocab.sentence_en: This hotel has a great reputation for excellent customer service.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這家飯店以優質的客戶服務享有盛譽。

vocab.definition_en: To believe that something is true or likely.
vocab.sentence_en: I suspect that the train will be late today.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我懷疑今天的火車會誤點。

items.title_en: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
items.title_zh: 英國喜劇演員羅素·布蘭德因強姦和性侵被判處超過 10 年徒刑
items.summary_en: A famous comedian was found guilty of rape and sexual assault. Six women brought the case against him. He will serve more than 10 years in prison.
items.summary_zh: 一位知名喜劇演員被判強姦和性侵罪名成立。六名女性對他提起了訴訟。他將在監獄服刑超過 10 年。
items.why_important_en: This case shows that even celebrities are held accountable for serious crimes.
items.why_important_zh: 此案顯示即使是名人也必須為嚴重罪行負責。

vocab.definition_en: Having done something wrong or illegal.
vocab.sentence_en: The jury found him guilty of the crime after the trial.
vocab.sentence_zh: 審判後，陪審團判定他犯下了該罪行。

vocab.definition_en: A legal matter that is decided in a court.
vocab.sentence_en: The lawyer is busy working on a new legal case.
vocab.sentence_zh: 律師正忙於處理一個新的法律案件。

items.title_en: Qantas to cut 850 Australian jobs and outsource work to India under AI-driven overhaul
items.title_zh: 澳洲航空在 AI 驅動的改革下將裁減 850 個澳洲職位並將工作外包至印度
items.summary_en: Qantas is cutting 850 jobs in Australia. They will move this work to India. This is part of a plan to use more AI technology.
items.summary_zh: 澳洲航空正在裁減澳洲的 850 個職位。他們將把這些工作轉移到印度。這是使用更多 AI 技術計畫的一部分。
items.why_important_en: This reflects a trend of companies using AI to replace human workers to save costs.
items.why_important_zh: 這反映了企業利用 AI 取代人力以節省成本的趨勢。

vocab.definition_en: To pay another company to do work for you.
vocab.sentence_en: Our company decided to outsource the IT support to a local firm.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們公司決定將 IT 支援外包給一家當地公司。

vocab.definition_en: To reduce the number or amount of something.
vocab.sentence_en: We need to cut our travel expenses this year.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們今年需要削減差旅費用。
